criteria.description: both actors must occupy the same conflict area within the PET window
criteria.reason: zone_occupancy needs concrete map coordinates, which a portable rubric must not carry

originalIntent: NHTSA pre-crash typology 27-31 (straight crossing paths, left turn across path). The discriminating metric for a crossing conflict is post-encroachment time, not headway; a junction encounter with PET above ~2.5 s is ordinary give-way behaviour. Bands are pre-registered from published test protocols, not fitted to observed results.
title: Path-crossing conflict at a junction: the crossing must be a genuine arrival conflict
